titulo: Ela humilhou o EX-NAMORADO por ser pobre... mas não imaginava quem ele havia se tornado!

planos.imagem: wide shot, cozy small bakery cafe interior, warm afternoon light through the front window, small round wooden tables, a rich couple walking in through the glass entrance door, the woman looking around with disdain
planos.movimento: the couple walks in through the glass door and looks around the cafe; the woman keeps her sunglasses on top of her head the whole time
planos.sfx: glass door opening with a small shop bell chime, footsteps on tile floor, soft cafe chatter, espresso machine in the background

planos.texto: Olha só, esse lugar aqui só tem pé-rapado, né?
planos.imagem: medium shot of the woman standing just inside the entrance of the cozy small bakery cafe interior, warm afternoon light through the front window, small round wooden tables, glass door behind her, looking around with disgust

planos.texto: Foi você que quis parar aqui, amor.
planos.imagem: medium shot of the man standing just inside the entrance of the cozy small bakery cafe interior, warm afternoon light through the front window, small round wooden tables, glass door behind him, smirking

cozy small bakery cafe interior, warm afternoon light through the front window, small round wooden tables, the rich couple now seated at a small round wooden table by the front window, a waiter in a beige apron walking up to their table holding a small notepad
planos.movimento: the waiter walks up and stops right beside their table; the woman looks up at him; everyone keeps the same clothes and the woman keeps her sunglasses on top of her head
planos.sfx: footsteps on tile floor, a chair creaking, soft cafe chatter

planos.texto: Boa tarde. Vão querer mais alguma coisa?
planos.imagem: medium close-up of the waiter standing right beside the window table, looking down politely at the seated couple, holding a small notepad, cafe window behind him

planos.texto: Lucas? Não acredito. Você ainda tá servindo café?
planos.imagem: medium close-up of the woman seated at the window table, looking up at the waiter standing right beside her, surprised

planos.texto: Então esse é o ex que você largou? Olha o avental dele.
planos.imagem: medium close-up of the man seated at the window table, looking up at the waiter standing beside the table, condescending smirk

planos.texto: Eu te falei. Ele nunca ia passar de balconista.
planos.imagem: close-up of the woman seated at the window table, laughing cruelly while looking up at the waiter beside her
close-up of the waiter standing beside the window table, calm, a subtle knowing smile, holding his small notepad
planos.movimento: the waiter calmly lowers the small order pad in his hand and gives a subtle confident smile, looking down at the couple; same clothes, same position beside the table
